mapper.select: select FINPROD_ID2 finprodId2, tpd.finprod_type foreignexChangeType, DATE_FORMAT(VAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') valDate, VALUATION valuation, mvf.CCY ccy, VALMODEL_ID valmodelId, DATASOURCE_TYPE datasourceType, INPUT_TYPE inputType from MST_VAL_FX mvf left join trd_product_deal tpd on tpd.trade_id = mvf.finprod_id2 where FINPROD_ID2 = #{finprodId2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATASOURCE_TYPE = #{datasourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{valDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
